title: lycianthes fugax
intro: Lycianthes fugax, commonly known as the Chilean potato or purple potato, is a type of flowering plant native to South America. This plant is valued for its edible tubers, which have been reported to possess several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The tubers of Lycianthes fugax contain bioactive constituents such as anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions including antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive compounds present in Lycianthes fugax may also help to protect against oxidative stress, improve cardiovascular health, and support the immune system.
